scenarios.title: C1 case: 220 reads, fully methylated
scenarios.desc: 220 reads at positions 1-4, all 220 methylated. Fix B is wrong against the floored model; the audit's C1 fix is right.

scenarios.title: Stronger: 250 reads at all 6 bases
scenarios.desc: 250 reads at every base, all methylated. Even the C1 fix fails (DBL_MIN padding); only log space holds.

scenarios.title: rDNA-like: 4,379 reads, unmethylated
scenarios.desc: 4,379 reads (the rDNA maximum) at positions 1-4, none methylated. The open states' binomials underflow to 0 and are floored to 1e-30.
